title: feat: Add new event
summary: A new integration event is added to the VAT Date Handler to allow partners to customize the VAT date validation logic without modifying standard code.
key_points: New integration event added to CheckVATDateCZL
Enables partners to adjust VAT date validation conditions
Addresses issue where Original Doc. VAT Date CZL field was incorrectly required at receipt posting
Event allows customization without direct standard code modification
quote: There is currently no integration event in VAT Date Handler CZL.CheckVATDateCZL allowing partners to adjust this condition without modifying standard code directly.
